about: Recommended posting windows per platform for the Moment posting-time planner. Each window is the overlap of 2025/2026 industry 'best time to post' reports, checked against the original pages on the collected_at date.
timezone_note: times are the audience's local time; every report used here normalizes to the local time of the audience, so convert to the followers' main timezone (Romania: Europe/Bucharest) before showing a clock time.

confidence_scale.high: two or more independent reports agree on the days and an overlapping window
confidence_scale.medium: one solid report, or reports that agree on the days but not the hours
confidence_scale.low: weak data or reports that conflict

notes: These are industry averages from tool vendors (Sprout Social, Buffer, Hootsuite, Metricool, Later), mostly from US-heavy customer bases, and the vendors measure engagement in different ways.
Romania-specific data is scarce: no Romanian study with its own dataset was found on 2026-11-07, only generic guides and timezone calculators.
The account's own analytics (Instagram/Facebook Insights 'when your followers are online', TikTok and YouTube analytics) beat any average; use them when available and treat this file as a fallback.
Stay online for the first hour after posting to reply to comments: early engagement decides the next wave of distribution.

platforms.avoid: Weekends (Saturday weakest) and the hours after midnight.
platforms.reason: Sprout Social 2026 puts the peak on Tuesday and Wednesday from noon into the evening and Buffer 2026 names Wednesday the best day with 12:00 and 18:00 slots, but Later (2024 data) found 03:00-06:00 best, so the hours conflict.
